chapter.verse: Khatvei Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah, “Sumhaupa khat in sumkempa khat a nei hi. Tua sumkempa in a topa sum a thangbawl thu midangte in topa kiangah a ko uh hi.
A topa in sumkempa sam a, ‘Nang thu ka zak teng bangci thu ahi hiam? Na sumkep ciamtehna lai hong pia in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, sumkep na nasem nawn kei ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Sumkempa in, ‘Tu-in ka topa in sumkep za panin hong kiasak zo ahih ciangin, bang ka ci hih ding hiam? Lo laih nading tha ka nei kei hi. Khutdawh ngen dingin ka maizum hi.
Sumkepna za hong kiatsak khit ciangin, midangte in amau innah hong tun’sak nadingun bang ka ci hih ding hiam ka thei ta hi,’ ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Tua khit ciangin a topa’ sum bate a vekpi-un sam a, ‘Ka topa kiangah leiba bangzah loh ding a om hiam?’ ci-in a masa penpa a dong hi.
Amah in, ‘Sathau langva phel zakhat ka ba hi,’ ci hi. Sumkempa in, ‘Na kiciamna lai la in la, tu-in sawmnga at meegmeeng in,’ a ci hi.
Midang khat kiangah, ‘Nang in bangzah na ba hiam” ci-in a dot ciangin amah in, ‘Mangbuh seeng zakhat ka ba hi,” a ci hi. Sumkempa in, ‘Na kiciamna lai la in la, sawmgiat na at ding hi,’ a ci hi.
Thuman lo sumkempa in pilna tawh ahih ciangin a topa in a phat hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitung’ tate in amau khang lakah khuavak’ tate sangin a pil zaw uh hi.
Ke’n kong cih-inah, aman lo sum tawh lawmte na ngah ding uh hi. Tua hi leh, tua sumte a bei ciangin a om tawntung buk sungah amaute in a hong tungsak ding uh hi.”
“Thu neute tungah a diktat mi in, thu liante tungah a diktat ding hi. Thu neute tungah a diktat lo mi in thu liante tungah a diktat kei ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin leitunga a naman lo sum tungah na diktat kei uh leh, sum taktak kua in no hong kemsak ding hiam?
Midangte’ sum tungah na diktat kei uh leh, kua in note sum hong kemsak ding hiam?

To nih’ na a sem khawm zo nasempa a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a tote khat mudahin khat a it ding hi. Khat beelin khat a simmawh ding hi. Note in Pasian’ na leh leitung sum na nasem khawm zo kei ding uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Dangka a deihgawh Farisaite in hih thu khempeuh a zak uh ciangin Zeisu a zahko uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in mite mai-ah phatna na lak nuam uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in note lungsim uh a thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mite phatna in Pasian mai-ah kihhuaina ahi hi.”
‘Johan hong pai dongin Pasian’ Thukham leh Pasian’ kamsangte thu akipanin Pasian’ Gam Lungdamna Thu kihilh a, mi khempeuh in tua gam sungah zawhthawh bawlin a lut nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian’ Thukham neupen a kipaihkhiat ding sangin, van leh lei a man’than nading a baihzaw ding hi.”
“A zi ma-a numei dang tawh a kiteengte in numei tawh a mawh hi. Pasal tawh a kikhensa numei a teen’pihte in numei tawh a mawh hi.”
“Nidang lai-inah sumhaupa khat a om hi. Tua pa in puansan leh saihadial puan silhin ni simin nuamin an pha bel ne-in a om hi.
Lazaras kici mizawng khat in a pumtangin meima vei a; sumhaupa’ kongbiang kiangah,
a sabuai tung pan an neng kiate a ngen hi. Uite in zong pai a, a meimate a liak uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin mizawngpa si a, vantungmite in Abraham’ ang ah a pua uh hi.
Sumhaupa zong si a, a kivui hi. Meikuang sungah gimna nakpi a thuak lai takin a khuadak leh, Abraham leh Abraham’ ang ah Lazaras a om gamlapi panin a gal muh hi.

‘Pa Abraham aw, kei hong hehpih in, Lazaras in a khutme dawn tui ah diah hen la, ka lei hong votsak nadingin ka kiangah hong sawl in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, hih meikuang sungah gimna nakpi ka thuak hi,’ ci-in a kiko hi.

Abraham in, ‘Ka ta aw, nang na nuntak lai-in nopsakna na ngah a, tua mah bangin Lazaras in zong a pha lo nate ngah hi ci-in na ngaihsun kik in. Tu-in ahih leh, amah in nopna a ngah kik hi. Nang na hih leh, gimna na thuak hi.

Tua tham loin nang leh ko kikalah a thuk mahmah guam khat a om hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih santak panin nangma kiangah a galkah nuamte in, a galkah zo kei uh hi. Tua santak pan ko kiangah hong galkah nuamte in zong hong galkah zo kei uh hi,’ a ci hi.
Sumhaupa in, ‘Pa aw, tua bang ahih leh, keimah in sanggam nga ka nei hi.
Amaute in hih gimna sungah a tun’ loh nading thu a hilh dingin ka pa’ innah Lazaras nong sawlsak nadingin kong ngen hi,’ a ci hi.
Abraham in, ‘Amaute in Moses leh Pasian’ kamsangte a nei uh hi.
Tuate thu ngai ta hen,’ a ci hi. Sumhaupa in, ‘Hi kei, pa Abraham aw, mi sisa khat hong thokikin amaute kiangah a pai leh, amaute in mawhna a kisikkik ding uh hi,’ a ci hi.
Abraham in, ‘Tuate in Moses’ thu leh Pasian’ kamsangte’ thu a ngaih kei uh leh, mi khat in sihna pan a hingkik zongin a taksang kei ding uh hi,’ a ci hi,” ci-in Zeisu in a gen hi.
